## Personality

Martin is considered an untrustworthy individual tasked with caring for livestock. Approaching the end of his life, he experiences feelings of loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P32](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0032)_

- lonely (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P32](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0032)</sub>

## History

Martin worked at Abernethy's farm for twelve months, during which time four people passed away. Having spent his entire life working too hard to form relationships, he lacked many friends. Despite this, he managed to accumulate a great deal of wealth over his lifetime.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P32](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0032)_
